name: hqbot
description: Open-source AI teammates on customer-owned Cloudflare infrastructure.

scripts.check: pnpm code:check && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm deploy:dry-run

AI.description: Workers AI plans and writes each Bot task.

BROWSER.description: Browser Run gives each task a real cloud browser.

ARTIFACTS.description: R2 stores browser screenshots and reviewable task artifacts.

HQBOT_AGENT.description: A Durable Object stores the Bot profile, transcript, tasks, and activity.

HQBOT_WORKFLOW.description: A Workflow runs durable research and reply tasks.

ASSETS.description: Worker Static Assets serves the HQBot web app.
